title: How to organise the bed and sleep zone | Kids Bedroom
description:
The place a child winds down and sleeps, and nothing else.

This is the Bed and Sleep Zone in the Kids Bedroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Duvet pulled flat with one pillow squared at the head. Three or four stuffed animals on the bed, the rest sitting in an open basket at the foot where they can still be seen. Nightlight cord run behind the bed leg. A clear walkable path from the pillow to the door, wide enough to cross in the dark without looking down.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Pull every stuffed animal out onto the floor and count what was actually in the bed.
Straighten: Give them bedding they can handle alone.
Shine: Strip the bed, vacuum the mattress, and get the strip of floor under it that nobody has seen since the frame w
Safety: Blind and blackout cords hanging near a bed head are a strangle risk at exactly the wrong height.
Standardize: Tape one photo of the made bed inside the wardrobe door at the child's eye height.
Sustain: The bed gets made while the school bag goes onto the shoulder, before anyone leaves the room.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One duvet, one pillow, and the animals that fit in two arms in a single trip.
